title: Matte Gray Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Valet Stand, Allied Brass
description: This 14-inch freestanding paper towel holder (paper towel stand) keeps a kitchen roll handy and your countertop organized. Available in Matte Gray. Matte Gray provides a sophisticated neutral. Built from solid brass, it delivers the durability shoppers want compared with lightweight alternatives. A solid brass weighted base helps prevent tipping during one-handed tearing, while the felt pad helps protect countertops from scratching. With a compact 5 in. L x 5 in. W footprint, this countertop paper towel valet fits neatly by the sink, range, or island and requires no wall mounting.  and backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Includes the paper towel holder.
